evals.name: run-a-complete-static-gate
evals.prompt: Validate a static site before Pages deployment using its sitemap and declared checks.
evals.fixtures: Repository with HTML, sitemap, generated index, fingerprints, and local server.
evals.output_contract: Evidence table with route inventory, exact commands, statuses, artifacts, and limitations.
evals.failure_consequence: An unvalidated release can deploy broken or stale public content.

expectations.text: Uses the sitemap as route source and reports count/routes.
Checks generated index and cache fingerprints in read-only mode.
Reports command, status, commit, and artifact per gate.

evals.name: protect-indexing-and-security-boundaries
evals.prompt: A noindex utility page is in the sitemap and an intended iframe is rejected by CSP. Interpret the release results.
evals.fixtures: Sitemap, HTML robots metadata, headers, and browser logs.
evals.output_contract: Blocked release report distinguishing indexing failure from external-content limitation.
evals.failure_consequence: Search pollution or unsafe security-policy weakening.

expectations.text: Requires noindex pages to be absent from the sitemap.
Does not weaken CSP or frame policy to make the iframe pass.
Labels third-party availability as unknown or blocked.

evals.name: refuse-incomplete-browser-evidence
evals.prompt: The browser runner skipped eight routes after a timeout and the generated index is missing. Should this release pass?
evals.fixtures: Partial browser log and missing index path.
evals.output_contract: Non-passing report with explicit next actions and no hidden writes.
evals.failure_consequence: A partial test could be misrepresented as a clean release.

expectations.text: Refuses to call the browser run clean when routes were skipped.
Treats a missing generated index as a failure.
Does not silently run a builder or modify the repository.
